target_customer: Salespeople, CTOs and CEOs of fast-growing startups that must answer enterprise security questionnaires to close deals
problem: Answering buyer security questionnaires eats engineering time and slows enterprise deals; companies also lack clear written security policies.

founders.name: Emre Murray Mangir
education: UC Berkeley, Applied Math and Economics
founders.background_notes: Only founder listed on the YC page. Later moved to a product role at Ashby.

technical_complexity.rationale: In 2021 the product parsed uploaded questionnaires and policy documents and matched answers to standards, which was mostly document parsing and workflow for a 4 person team. Large language models were not yet the base layer.

defensibility.rationale: Little proprietary data or integration depth for a four person team, and larger compliance platforms could add the same feature.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The wedge was absorbed by a trust center vendor: SafeBase bought Stacksi in September 2023 to add questionnaire automation.

market_need_then: Enterprise buyers routinely sent long security questionnaires to startups, and the YC description frames them as a drag on salespeople and engineers. No quantified spend figure was found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and benefit led on the YC profile (close deals faster, save engineers time).

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand or community evidence found; the website now returns 404 after the acquisition and the name was folded into SafeBase.

outcome_analysis: Stacksi stayed tiny, a four person team with no verified institutional funding, and was bought by the trust center company SafeBase in September 2023 for undisclosed terms. The product fit SafeBase's roadmap, so the outcome reads as a small tuck in acquisition of a niche feature rather than a standalone success or a clear failure. The founder later moved to a product role at Ashby.
notes: Funding: aggregators (PitchBook, CB Insights) show roughly 125K to 130K total, seen only in aggregator snippets, so unverified and not recorded as a round. No competitor source dated near early 2021 was found; competitor names in later comparison pages are from 2024 to 2026 and excluded. Company website returns 404. Headquarters differs by source (Los Angeles, San Francisco, Sacramento). success_factors is weak evidence.
